source.name: VfL Wolfsburg - Partners: VfL's primary partner
source.quote: Volkswagen AG is Europe's largest car manufacturer as well as the primary sponsor and owner of VfL Wolfsburg Fußball-GmbH.

note: Long-standing front-of-shirt sponsor and owner. Reported values disagree and mix the shirt with the stadium deal: Sky Sport (18 Mar 2026) reports more than €70m a year for the wider Volkswagen support including shirt sponsorship and stadium naming rights; IHK Lüneburg-Wolfsburg (2026) reports €80m for shirt and stadium sponsorship in the previous season; Lente Desportiva (10 Jul 2025) put the main-shirt deal alone at €70m a year. Value left null - see PR.
